description: This file contains Flask-based view classes for authentication and user registration in the Superset project, including login, registration, and account activation functionalities.

classes.name: SupersetAuthView
classes.description: Handles user login via Flask views, extending AuthView with custom login route.

classes.name: SupersetRegisterUserView
classes.description: Manages user registration and account activation, including email-based activation URL handling.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Handles user login, redirects authenticated users to the index page.

methods.name: activation
methods.description: Handles account activation via a URL containing an activation hash, creates user account if valid.
